$comment: Vendorized snapshot of the open Agent Skills standard frontmatter contract, from agentskills.io/specification, snapshot dated 2025-12-18. This schema is the EXTERNAL conformance check only: it encodes exactly what the Agent Skills spec allows at the top level of a SKILL.md frontmatter block, and nothing aiadev-specific. Do not add aiadev-internal fields here; those live in schemas/skill-frontmatter.schema.json under metadata.aiadev. Directory-name matching for `name` is enforced by code, not by this schema.
title: Agent Skills Standard Frontmatter
description: Conformance schema for the open Agent Skills standard (agentskills.io) SKILL.md frontmatter contract.

name.description: Lowercase kebab-case skill identifier, 1-64 chars. Must equal the containing skill directory name (checked by tooling, not by this schema).

description.description: Non-empty summary used by agents to decide when to invoke the skill.

license.description: Optional license identifier or attribution string.

compatibility.description: Optional free-form map describing runtime/tooling compatibility constraints.

metadata.description: Optional free-form map of additional metadata. Values may be any YAML/JSON type; namespaced keys (e.g. org.example.key) are recommended to avoid collisions.

allowed-tools.description: Experimental: restrict which tools the skill may call, either as an array of tool names or as a space/comma-separated string.
